notes:
Improve server-list authentication and rate-limit handling.

- Show a Browser Login prompt when Roblox rejects the selected account session (HTTP 401).
- Stop region requests after authentication failure, including pagination and retries, until the list is refreshed or another account is selected.
- Browse public servers independently of the selected account session.
- Share a short-lived server-page cache and honor Roblox Retry-After cooldowns.
- Keep already-loaded servers if refreshing the list is rate limited.

An expired or rejected Roblox session still requires signing in again.
